method: BASELINE. Seat-neutral core in the rule's own terms (ri-works.l4), with a parent/caretaker seat layer (ri-works-seat.l4) that calls it and restates no rule; the duties to report changes (s 2.21.2) and return the Interim Report (ss 2.22.1, 2.22.2) are regulative MUST rules, the hearing rights (s 2.11.12) MAY rules; written straight from the deposited text with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: 218-RICR-20-00-2 as in force on 2026-10-24 (Technical Revision, effective 2025-02-16 to 2026-11-10), deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/218-ricr-20-00-2-2025-02-16.txt; the Amendment effective 2026-11-10 (deposited as 218-ricr-20-00-2-2026-11-10.txt) is followed for the child support exclusion in months from that date. The enabling statute, R.I. Gen. Laws ch. 40-5.2, is not deposited.

seat: the parent or caretaker relative who applies for, or receives, RI Works cash assistance (Rhode Island's TANF programme)
scope: ss 2.5.2(A), 2.18.3(A)(1)(b) (eligible child by age); 2.14.1(A), 2.14.2(F)(1)(a), (2) (resources, vehicles); 2.15.3(D) (both versions), (E); 2.15.5(A), (B)(1)-(2); 2.18.1, 2.18.2, 2.18.3(A)(5), 2.18.5(A)-(B); 2.6(A), (D), 2.6.1, 2.6.3(A), 2.6.4(A); 2.11.11(A)-(B); 2.11.12(A); 2.21.2(A)-(B) (regulative); 2.22.1(A), 2.22.2(B) (regulative); 2.29.1(B), (C)(4); 2.29.3(A). Out: the assistance unit's make-up (s 2.4, plan size is an input), non-financial requirements other than age, non-citizens and sponsor deeming (s 2.17), child support cooperation (s 2.7), employment plans and work activities (ss 2.10, 2.11.1-2.11.10), minor parents (s 2.12), domestic violence waivers (s 2.13), real-property and other resource details, self-employment and rental income, deemed income (ss 2.15.9, 2.16), first-month proration (s 2.18.5(C)), the post-closure bonus (s 2.18.6), EBT, overpayments and claims (ss 2.24-2.28).
links: us/social-security-act (Title IV-A TANF, 42 U.S.C. 601-619; the 60-month limit in s 608(a)(7) is the federal frame for s 2.6)
